shared_elements: carved stone slab/pillar with tall rectangular format
low relief on a flat recessed ground
horizontal band of repeated pattern (zigzag/wavy line) running across the width
raised rectangular block or ledge at the lower part
justification: Both are tall weathered stone slabs bearing shallow relief with a left-facing profile head in the upper-middle zone and a horizontal band of repeated zigzag/wavy ornament crossing the field, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a multi-register composition of schematic, flat, linear animal figures stacked in tiers, while B is a single large, rounded and volumetrically modelled figure with a detailed headdress filling nearly the whole surface, so the carving manner and compositional logic differ substantially.
